description: Lists the workspace prospects by lifecycle and source, optionally scoped to a list or a tag, starred only, matching address or name words, by status, by who added them, or by when they were added. Paged, up to 100 per page. Free.

added_after.description: Only prospects added on or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date such as 2026-10-01 means midnight UTC

added_before.description: Only prospects added before this ISO 8601 date or date-time (not including it). A date means midnight UTC

added_by.description: Only prospects added by these user IDs, such as [7, 12]

search.description: Address words for properties; name or city words for people

source.description: How the prospect was added. Use driving for prospects added during drives.

source_group.description: d4d for prospects added while driving; map for prospects added any other way

status.description: Only prospects with any of these statuses; none means no status set

tag_id.description: Only prospects with this tag, such as `tag_31`

name: dealmachine_prospect_search
